Author: ahadev
Name: BladUI
Description:
Your inventory, your way — a Baldur's Gate-style inventory window for FFXIV.

• Multiselect: click, Ctrl+Click, Shift+Click ranges, Ctrl+A — then move everything in one click.
• Your own layout: drag-arranged custom order that ignores the game's slot shuffle, plus sort by type, name, item level, rarity, and more, with search and category filters.
• Rarity-colored tiles, rich tooltips, gearset badges, HQ marks.
• Ctrl+Click instant move to the open retainer or saddlebag; send gear to its correct armoury slot.
• Wares: mark your to-sell pile (with live market-vs-vendor comparison via universalis.app).
• Utilities: reviewable bulk actions — clean out your armoury chest, auto-mark vendor trash — every step previewed before it runs.
• Use items and assign hotbar slots from the window.

Every action maps to a normal player click, validated by the game — BladUI saves clicks, never automates.
Punchline: Baldur's Gate-style inventory: multiselect, bulk move, one-click armoury cleanup.

Author: ahadev
Name: Polite Eorzea
Description:
Polite Eorzea sends a greeting or a farewell to your party (or alliance) from your own list of messages.

• /hi and /bye send a random greeting or farewell right away.
• Auto mode greets when you enter an instanced duty and says thanks when it completes.
• Picks party or alliance chat automatically; skips solo duties.
• Fully editable message lists, delays and triggers in /polite.
Punchline: Say hello and thank your party with one command, or automatically in duties.
